name: costas_array_n6__v5_nh
prompt:
Find a Costas array of order 6: place 6 marks on an 6x6 grid, one per row and one per column, such that all 6*(5)/2 displacement vectors (dr, dc) between pairs of marks (with dc > 0) are pairwise distinct.

Return x as a list of 6 integers in 0..5, where x[c] is the row of the mark in column c (permutation), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such array exists.
